subject.title: chore(autoreview): sync hardened org review defaults

question: After current canonical parity is restored, should OpenClaw adopt the narrowed reviewer-engine set and changed Codex default/fallback policy?
rationale: Exact canonical resynchronization is mechanical, but intentionally breaking existing maintainer review invocations requires tooling-owner intent.

options.title: Resync and adopt
options.body: Update to one current canonical snapshot, rerun focused validation, and accept its engine and model-selection contract.

options.title: Require upstream transition
options.body: Retain the current OpenClaw interfaces until the canonical source provides an approved deprecation or compatibility path.

recommendation.title: Resync and adopt
recommendation.body: Update to one current canonical snapshot, rerun focused validation, and accept its engine and model-selection contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The newest canonical reasoning-policy change and prior Codex default/fallback commits provide the strongest decision-owner signal.
